monsterDescriptions.text: Long ago a wizard's experiment had gone afoul and this is the result.
Though they are not difficult to kill, take care.  Their bite is most poisonous.
Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together and you have a four footed eating machine with sharp teeth.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into for noone has ever found one in a cocoon state.
Capable of launching a multitude of attacks, this critter is extremely deadly.
Strongest of the good dragons.  This race of dragon kind devotes there entire lives to the destructin of there evil kin.
A gaping maw of immense size makes this mindless foe one to best avoided.
Sickly in appearance, these fould creatures blend in the very surrounding and pounce on the unsuspecting.
A truely fearsom arachnid.  Avoid contact with this 8-legged monstrosity if at all possable.
Minotaurs have a stout body that would make even an ogre quake with fright.   These powerfull creatures love to engage in combat.

A larger version of the ordinary troll.  The physical strength of these beasts is near god-like.
Often used to guard magical treasure or some important location.
A mountainous man-fish.
Though they look fierce, they are not as deadly as one might think.
Large and deadly.  There saliva containes a strange chemical that causes those that do not save to become deathly afraid.
An odd sight indeed.  There appearance would be laughable if they were not so deadly.  They favor the occasional orc to dine on.
A strange cross between a Hyena and a tiger.  Nobody knows if it was spawned from magic or nature.
Large but stupid.  These reptiles have been known to trample a full grown ogre without even slowing down.
Do not get too close.  If it get's you in a bear hug you are doomed for sure.
Older and stronger than your average bear. (But not any smarter!)
Be careful not to fall victim to a bite from one of these.  There bite has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they look.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Younger and weaker than their older counterparts, these evil creatures still pack a mean bite.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few are those that have met with one, and LIVED!
Woe are the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one of this ilk.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Large and heavily armored with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
Large and brutish.  These simple minded humanoids survive due to there shear size.
A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.
A smaller dinosaur that must hunt in packs in order to bring down larger prey.
Standing 8 feet tall or more these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often emplyed as troops in mercinary armies.
A strong family structure allows these giant reptiles to survive in a hostile environment.
Young and weak when compared to a full grown giant.  Still more than a match for any full grown human or orc.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts make excellent warriors.
Niether very fast nor powerful, these nasty reptiles do have one advantage.  A poison bite.
Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerfull enchanters to do their bidding.
Though not native to the nine planes of hell, they populate large regions of that foul area.
These creatures favored attack is to lower there armored head and charge.  Hint:  Don't stand in front of it when it does.
True to her word, this little critter will suck your soul.
These minor devils live there lives as servents to those more powerfull than themselvs.
This beast has lost his master and will do anything to find him.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your very life force.
These creatures are almost indestructable.
The race of giants can also become undead, as this creature will attest.  Slow and mindless, this zombie can still pack a punch.
A common thug ruled by greed.
They can cause a nasty chemical burn.

A creature of the undead.  The touch of these foul creatures is capable of causing disease.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
Master of the mind and physical attacks, the hands of this monk are more deadly than most swords.  His body also regenerates his wounds.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
A small reptilian race.  They are extremely evil and travel in large groups.
A giant boar.  Not much else to tell.
Human Mage
Completly mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by just about any other demon.
Found in the land beyond the Fingertip mountains, this little girl needs help getting home.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Small and weak, goblins band together in large tribes for there own protection.
A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these nether-world creatures is almost without compare.
Normaly they feed on only the dead, but in times of hunger they will hunt prey.
Abused as a youngster.  These ill tempered men are but common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.
Half man, half fish, all bad temper.
A small but deadly version of your everyday troll.
An stange critter.  It will inflict great mental damage from time time.
Only slightly less primative than a cave man.  These humanoids are all but animal.
A mighty paladin in his day, Thyrr is still a most worthy opponent.
A now retired mage, Cindred still knows his spells.
